items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Bill told me yesterday... Bill used to play saxophone... I'm talking about that between him and Bill.

ctx.x: I couldn't bring myself to go see him when he had that chance. I just...
Well, you know, Bill... Bill stopped... Stopped with his... What is this?
You know that chorus, huh? He's imitating somebody, you know. He's not the real man.
